title: Stochastic maximal $L^p$-regularity for non-autonomous evolution equations with fractional derivative in UMD spaces
summary: This paper is concerned with the maximal regularity theory for non-autonomous stochastic evolution equations with a generalized fractional derivative in UMD spaces. The generalized time-fractional derivative provides a unified framework covering both the classical Riemann-Liouville and Caputo fractional derivatives, which accommodates a wider class of anomalous diffusion processes with intermediate memory effects.
